meta.title: A late bid that changes the leader extends the auction by the configured minutes
gaps: No setup recipe creates a rank auction with three QA vendors, tied bids, dynamic closing, a one-minute trigger, a two-minute extension, and rank limit 1.
Only two vendors are available through the supplied recipes and tokens; vendor 3 cannot be created or invited.
The acts do not place the decisive bid inside the last minute or guarantee that it changes the leader.

The available read-back fields do not expose dynamic-closing settings or provide an assertion comparing the ending_at values before and after the bid, so the exact two-minute extension cannot be verified.
it does not read the record back to confirm what was kept or shown

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for only about two minutes.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live pricing round.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
A second QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
The buyer reads the pricing round.
